name: Hermes Agent
tagline: Self-improving terminal agent that runs locally or on container and serverless backends.
description: An open-source coding and general-purpose agent from Nous Research with persistent memory and a skills system that it extends as it works. It runs in a TUI or desktop app, supports subagents, worktree-isolated sessions, MCP servers, and seven terminal backends including Docker, SSH, Modal, Daytona and Vercel Sandbox, and can be reached through Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp or Signal.

pricing.notes: Open source under MIT; provider access is your own, optionally through a Nous Portal subscription.
